title: Samattam
text: 1--2. Taṃ yeva nidānaṃ || || Ekam antam- -Anuruddham etad avoca || || 3. Asekho asekho ti āvuso Anuruddha vuccati || kittāvatā nu kho āvuso Asekho hotī ti || || Catunnaṃ kho āvuso satipaṭṭhānānam samattam bhāvitattā asekho hoti || || Katamesaṃ catunnaṃ || || 4. Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || Vedanāsu || Citte || Dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassam || || Imesaṃ kho āvuso catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ samattā bhāvitattā asekho hotī ti || ||
